name: AFB – Auto Form Builder with AI, Contact & Conversational Forms
author: Ali Ghasemirad

sections.description:
Support

Watch the full overview video below.

Auto Form Builder is a free drag-and-drop WordPress form builder for creating professional forms — contact forms, multi-step forms, surveys, file upload forms, and forms with conditional logic — without writing a single line of code.

It also brings AI to your forms. With the optional AI add-ons you can build a form with AI from a plain-English description or an uploaded document, generate conditional logic automatically, summarize and draft replies to submissions, ask questions across all your submissions, and use a built-in admin AI assistant that answers questions about your forms and even creates new ones. You can also turn any form into an AI conversational form — a friendly chat that collects answers naturally instead of a static layout.

The core drag-and-drop builder and every non-AI feature are completely free, with no upsells hidden behind core functionality. The AI features are optional and off by default: they connect to our AIDA service only after you opt in, with free trial credits to start and paid credit packs afterward (see the “External Services” section for the full disclosure).

Why Auto Form Builder?

Most form plugins lock their best features behind expensive subscriptions. Auto Form Builder gives you multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization — all completely free.

Plugin Dashboard

Your command center for everything forms-related. The plugin dashboard opens with a personalized greeting and live summary, four KPI cards (total forms, total submissions, unread entries, and this week’s activity with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day submission activity chart, the latest entries, a top-performing-forms ranking, built-in add-on status at a glance, and one-click shortcuts to create forms, open settings, or get support. If you have not created a form yet, a guided onboarding card walks you through the first three steps.

Drag & Drop Form Builder

Building a form takes minutes. Open the builder, drag your fields onto the canvas, and you’re done. The builder supports undo/redo, a live preview with desktop, tablet, and mobile views, and instant shortcode generation so you can embed your form anywhere on your site.

Embed Forms on Any Website

Your forms aren’t locked to your WordPress site. Every form comes with a ready-made embed code you can copy from the Forms screen and paste onto any website — including sites that don’t run WordPress, and page builders such as WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embedded form keeps the exact design you built, automatically resizes to fit its content with no inner scrollbar, and stays isolated from the host site’s theme so it always looks right. You can even choose to have a redirect thank-you page open in the full browser window, breaking out of the frame. It’s the same secure form, working anywhere you place it.

15+ Field Types

Every common field type is included:

  • Text Input
  • Textarea
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Date & Time
  • Checkbox
  • Radio Buttons
  • Dropdown
  • Name Field
  • Address
  • File Upload
  • Signature
  • Color Picker
  • Page Break (multi-step forms)
  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid)
  • Star Rating
  • NPS (0–10)
  • Opinion Scale

Signature Field

Collect legally-style e-signatures right inside your form. Visitors sign with a mouse, finger, or stylus on a signature pad, and the drawing is saved with the submission. Signatures are stored securely and shown as an image in the entry details, so they’re perfect for consent forms, agreements, and approvals — and they work both on your WordPress pages and in embedded forms.

Survey Fields & Visual Results

Build complete surveys with four dedicated question types — features other form plugins charge for, included here free:

  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid) — rows of questions with your own answer columns, as radio buttons or checkboxes (multiple answers per row). The table collapses neatly on mobile.
  • Star Rating — 3 to 10 stars with hover preview, fully keyboard and touch accessible.
  • NPS (0–10) — the standard “How likely are you to recommend us?” Net Promoter Score scale with color-coded Detractor/Passive/Promoter answers.
  • Opinion Scale — numbered buttons with custom labels for each end, like “Not likely” and “Very likely”.

Then open the Survey Results screen for visual, per-question reports: answer distribution charts for ratings and scales, stacked bars for tabular surveys, an automatically calculated NPS score with the Promoter/Passive/Detractor breakdown, and a 30-day response trend. Survey answers also appear beautifully formatted in the entry details and as readable text in CSV exports — and conditional logic works with every survey field, so you can show follow-up questions based on a visitor’s rating.

Color Picker Field

Let visitors choose a color using the browser’s native color picker — ideal for design requests, product personalization, and print orders. The selected color is validated, stored with the submission, and displayed as a color swatch next to its hex code in the entry details.

Pre-Built Templates

Start faster with ready-to-use form templates including Contact Form, Feedback Form, Support Request, Newsletter Signup, Event Registration, and more. Every template is fully customizable after creation.

Conditional Logic

Show or hide any field based on what a user has already entered. Set multiple conditions per field using AND or OR logic. Build smart, dynamic forms that adapt to each visitor — all without any code.

Conditional logic goes beyond fields. You can also show a different success message or redirect to a different thank-you page depending on the visitor’s answers, and control your emails with the same rules — route the admin notification to a different address, change its subject or message, skip it entirely, or send a different confirmation email to the user. The first matching rule wins, and if nothing matches your normal settings apply.

Multi-Step Forms

Break long forms into short, friendly steps and watch your completion rates climb. Enable multi-step mode in Form Settings, then drop Page Break fields wherever a new step should begin. Give each step its own title, customize the Next and Previous button labels, and pick a progress bar style so visitors always know how far along they are.

Step branching makes multi-step forms smart: skip a step or jump ahead based on earlier answers (forward-only and loop-safe), so every visitor only sees the steps that apply to them. Perfect for application forms, quote requests, registrations, and questionnaires.

Partial Entries — Capture Abandoned Forms

Don’t lose a lead just because someone didn’t press Submit. With partial entry capture enabled, in-progress answers are saved while visitors fill out your form, and you can review them on the Partial Entries screen. Abandoned entries are deleted automatically after a retention period you control (1–365 days), keeping your data tidy and privacy-friendly.

Full Visual Customization

Make your forms match your brand perfectly. The Customize tab gives you control over:

  • Theme presets — Corporate, Minimal, Modern, Eco, Friendly, Luxury, Neutral, Creative, Feminine, Fresh, and more
  • Header image / banner per form
  • Background, colors, fonts, layout
  • Field styling and button design
  • Visual effects

Every change is previewed live across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Submission Management

All your form submissions are organized in a clean inbox-style interface with Unread, Starred, Read, Spam, and Trash tabs. Search submissions by any field value — name, email, phone, or any custom field. Filter by form or date range, sort by newest or oldest, and print submissions directly from the dashboard.

Email Notifications

Get notified instantly when a form is submitted. Admin notification emails and user confirmation emails are both supported and fully configurable per form — recipients, subject, and a custom message with placeholders like {submission_data} and {form_name}. Choose between a styled HTML layout or a simple plain-text format for each email, and use conditional rules to send different emails (or none at all) based on the visitor’s answers.

Form Analytics

Track exactly how your forms are performing. The analytics dashboard shows total views, total submissions, average conversion rate, and per-form breakdowns — all with a 30-day activity chart. Sync historical submissions, and reset data anytime. Form analytics is included free and activatable from the Add-Ons page.

Spam Protection

Two spam protection options are included free:

  • Google reCAPTCHA — industry-standard bot protection
  • Cloudflare Turnstile — a privacy-first, user-friendly CAPTCHA alternative with a better experience for real visitors

Both are activatable from the Add-Ons page. Use one or both on any form.

User Registration & Login

Turn any form into a registration form. Map your form’s fields to the account email, username, password, and first/last name (a single Full Name field is split automatically), pick the role new users receive (Administrator is never allowed), and optionally send your own custom welcome email with placeholders like {username} and {set_password_url}. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and are never stored with the submission or included in notification emails.

The add-on also gives you a fully independent login form via the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode. Signing in, lost password, and choosing a new password all happen on your own page — visitors never see the default WordPress login screen. Customize the labels, button text, colors, and corner radius to match your site.

Import & Export

Export your forms and entries for backup or migration. Import forms onto any WordPress site in seconds. Perfect for agencies managing multiple client sites.

Slack Notifications

Get your team notified in Slack the moment a form is submitted. Activate the free Slack Notifications add-on, paste a Slack Incoming Webhook URL from your own workspace, and choose which forms send a message — different forms can post to different Slack channels. Decide per form whether the submitted answers are included, and verify your setup with a one-click test message.

Built with safety first: only hooks.slack.com webhook URLs are accepted, no Slack credentials are ever stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.

Webhooks

Connect your forms to any external service or automation platform using built-in webhook support. Send submission data to Zapier, Make, or any custom endpoint the moment a form is submitted.

Extend with Paid Add-Ons

The free plugin is complete and fully functional on its own. For teams and agencies that want to go further, premium add-ons are available to extend specific functionality.

Auto Form CRM Integration

Auto Form Builder integrates natively with Auto Form CRM, a dedicated WordPress CRM plugin built for managing leads and form submissions in one place.

AI Features (Optional Add-Ons)

Two optional AI add-ons are available and off by default: AI Assistant (build a form from a description or an uploaded document, one-click submission summaries and suggested replies, “ask across your submissions”, and an admin chat assistant that can answer questions about your forms and even create new forms) and AI Conversation (turn a form into a friendly chat that collects answers conversationally, with optional appointment booking).

These features connect to AIDA, our AI service at autoformcrm.com. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you activate an AI add-on and connect a free AIDA account. New accounts include free trial credits; after the trial, AI usage requires one-time credit packs purchased on autoformcrm.com — so the AI features are a paid service, while the core form builder and every non-AI feature stay completely free and never require an account. Your credit balance is always visible inside the plugin. See the “External Services” section below for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.

External Services

Auto Form Builder is privacy-first. By default the plugin does not contact any external service. The following optional services are off by default and only ever run after you actively opt in:

AIDA — AI Assistant & AI Conversation (optional add-ons, off by default)

  • Service: AIDA — the AI service that powers the plugin’s optional AI features.
  • Provider: Auto Form Builder / Auto Form CRM (https://autoformcrm.com/). AIDA processes each request using a third-party AI provider, Anthropic (https://www.anthropic.com/).
  • When it is contacted: Only after a site administrator activates one of the optional AI add-ons (AI Assistant or AI Conversation) and connects an AIDA account, and then uses an AI feature. If the AI add-ons are not activated, or you never connect an account, nothing is ever sent to AIDA. The core form builder never contacts AIDA.
  • Account required: Using the AI features requires an AIDA account. Creating an account is free and includes free trial credits; once the trial credits are used, continued AI usage requires purchasing credits (one-time credit packs, purchased on autoformcrm.com). In other words, the AI features are a paid service after the free trial, while the core Auto Form Builder plugin and all non-AI features remain completely free and never require an account.
  • Data that is sent, and when:
    • Form building (AI Assistant): the form description you type, and the contents of any document you upload to build a form from, are sent when you request an AI-generated form.
    • Submission AI (AI Assistant): the content of the specific submission(s) you act on is sent when you request a summary, a suggested reply, or an “ask across submissions” answer, and when the admin chat assistant uses its data tools to answer a question about your forms or submissions.
    • Admin chat assistant (AI Assistant): the messages you type into the assistant are sent when you send them.
    • Conversations (AI Conversation): if you enable the AI Conversation add-on on a public form, the chat messages that site visitors type into that form’s assistant are sent when they send them, so the assistant can reply and collect the form’s answers.
    • Authentication: your AIDA account connection token is sent (server-side only) to authenticate each request. It is stored encrypted on your server and is never exposed to the browser.
  • Data that is NOT sent: no request is made for any AI feature you do not use, and no submission or form content is sent outside of the AI action you trigger. Passwords handled by WordPress core are never sent.
  • Metering: AI usage is metered in credits. Your current balance is shown in the plugin’s AI settings, and you can buy more credits at any time — this always opens autoformcrm.com in a new browser tab; no payment is ever processed inside the plugin.
  • Purpose: To provide the optional AI features — AI-assisted form building, submission summaries and replies, the admin assistant, and visitor-facing conversational forms.
  • Provider terms / privacy policy: https://autoformcrm.com/terms and https://autoformcrm.com/privacy (Auto Form CRM / AIDA). AI processing is performed by Anthropic — see https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy.

Anonymous Deactivation Feedback (opt-in, one-time)

  • Service: Auto Form Builder feedback endpoint
  • Endpoint: https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-deactivation-feedback.php
  • Provider: Auto Form Builder (https://autoformbuilder.com/)
  • When …
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Auto Form Builder”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Navigate to Auto Form Builder in your admin menu
  5. Click Create New Form to build your first form
  6. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page or post
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free?

Yes. Auto Form Builder is 100% free. Multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization are all included at no cost. Optional paid add-ons are available for extended functionality.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. The drag-and-drop builder requires zero coding knowledge. Everything from building to styling to embedding is handled through the visual interface.

Can I add conditional logic to my forms?

Yes. Every field supports conditional logic. You can show or hide fields based on other field values, using AND or OR conditions, with multiple conditions per field.

What field types are available?

Text Input, Textarea, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Time, Checkbox, Radio Buttons, Dropdown, Name, Address, File Upload, Signature, Color Picker, Page Break (for multi-step forms), and four survey fields: Tabular Survey (Likert grid), Star Rating, NPS, and Opinion Scale.

Can I create multi-step forms?

Yes. Enable multi-step mode in Form Settings and add Page Break fields where each new step should start. You get step titles, custom Next/Previous button labels, progress bar styles, and answer-based step branching that can skip steps or jump ahead so visitors only see what applies to them.

Can I see answers from visitors who never finished the form?

Yes. Turn on partial entry capture and in-progress answers are saved while visitors fill out the form. Review them on the Partial Entries screen, and let abandoned entries auto-delete after a retention period you choose (1–365 days).

Can I get Slack notifications for form submissions?

Yes. Activate the free Slack Notifications add-on, paste your Slack Incoming Webhook URL, and enable it for any form. Different forms can notify different Slack channels, and you choose per form whether the submitted answers are included in the message.

Can I embed my form on another website?

Yes. Every form comes with a ready-made embed code — click “Copy embed code” on the Forms screen and paste it into any website, including non-WordPress sites and page builders like WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embedded form keeps your original design, resizes automatically to fit its content, and stays isolated from the host site’s styles. You can also copy a direct link to the form and share it as its own page.

Can visitors sign my forms with an e-signature?

Yes. Add the Signature field and visitors can draw their signature with a mouse, finger, or stylus. The signature is stored securely with the submission and shown as an image in the entry details — on your WordPress pages and in embedded forms.

Can users register and log in through my forms?

Yes. Activate the free User Registration & Login add-on, pick which form creates accounts, and map its fields to the account email, username, password, and name. You can choose the role new users receive, customize the welcome email, and add a fully independent login form to any page with the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode — including lost password and password reset, all without the default WordPress login screen.

Can I protect my forms from spam?

Yes. Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile are both included as free built-in add-ons. Activate either or both from the Add-Ons page.

Can I track form performance?

Yes. The built-in Form Analytics add-on tracks views, submissions, and conversion rates per form with a 30-day activity chart.

Can I export form submissions?

Yes. You can export forms and entries from the Settings > Import/Export tab.

Does it support webhooks?

Yes. Built-in webhook support lets you send submission data to Zapier, Make, or any external endpoint.

Do the AI features cost money?

The core form builder is free and always will be — you never need an account for it. The optional AI features (the AI Assistant and AI Conversation add-ons) run on our AIDA service. Creating an AIDA account is free and comes with free trial credits; once those are used up, continued AI usage requires purchasing one-time credit packs on autoformcrm.com. So AI is a paid service after the free trial, while everything else in the plugin stays free. Your credit balance is always visible in the plugin.

What data is sent to external services when I use the AI features?

Only when you actually use an AI feature, and only the content that feature needs: the form description or uploaded document when building a form; the submission content when you summarize, reply, or “ask across submissions”, or when the admin assistant answers a question; the messages you type into the admin assistant; and — only if you enable AI Conversation on a public form — the chat messages that site visitors type into that form. Requests are authenticated with your AIDA account token (kept encrypted on your server) and processed by our AI provider, Anthropic. Nothing is sent unless you opt in and use the feature. See the “External Services” section above for the full disclosure.

Can I use the plugin without the AI features?

Yes. Auto Form Builder is fully functional without any AI. The AI add-ons are optional and off by default — nothing is sent anywhere unless you activate an AI add-on and connect an AIDA account. If you never opt in, the plugin never contacts AIDA, and every non-AI feature works exactly as before.

Where can I get support?

Visit autoformbuilder.com/support for documentation and support.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

Released: 2026-08-06.

  • New: AI Assistant add-on (optional, off by default) — connect a free AIDA account to bring AI to your forms:
    • Build a form with AI from a plain-English description.
    • Document-to-form — upload a document and turn it into a ready-to-edit form.
    • Automatic conditional logic generation as part of AI form building.
    • One-click submission summaries and AI-drafted replies.
    • “Ask across your submissions” — answer questions spanning all entries of a form.
    • Admin AI chat assistant — a built-in assistant that answers questions about your forms and submissions and can create new forms for you.
  • New: AI Conversation add-on (now built-in, optional, off by default) — turn any form into a friendly conversational form: an AI chat that collects answers naturally, with optional appointment booking via Auto Form CRM.
  • New: AIDA credits — a single shared credit balance that powers both AI add-ons, always visible in the plugin. New accounts start with free trial credits; afterward, top up with one-time credit packs purchased on autoformcrm.com in a new tab (no payment ever happens inside the plugin). See the AIDA entry in the “External Services” section of this readme for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.
  • Note: The core drag-and-drop form builder and all non-AI features remain completely free and never require an account. The AI features are opt-in and connect to AIDA only after you activate an AI add-on.

1.3.1

  • New: Per-component Required checkboxes on the Address field for Address Line 2, State/Province/Region, ZIP/Postal Code, Country, and Company/Organization — each appears under its component in Advanced Settings and can be toggled independently.
  • Improved: Marking the Address field itself Required now automatically requires the two always-rendered core components (Address Line 1 and City), so a required address can no longer be submitted empty.
  • Improved: Address country component — when the country is shown and Required, no default country is silently preselected (visitors must choose explicitly), and Hide Country never bypasses a shown, required country.
  • Improved: Address renderer skips the Required flag for any component that is hidden, so a “required” toggle on a disabled component never blocks submission.
  • Fixed: Conditional logic now works in every copy of a form on the page, including page-builder popups (Brizy, Elementor, WP Bakery, etc.) that clone or lazy-inject form markup — the manager tracks every DOM instance and listens at the document capture phase so overlays that stop event propagation cannot silence it.
  • Fixed: Multi-step forms now correctly hide inactive steps even when a site serves a stale cached stylesheet — steps are hidden inline in addition to via CSS.
  • Fixed: Required Name field with “Separate fields (First name, Last name)” enabled now validates the subfield values correctly and no longer reports the field as missing when it was filled in.
  • Fixed: Required Address field now validates the submitted address components correctly and no longer reports the field as missing when it was filled in.
  • Fixed: Required radio groups are enforced even when a page builder strips the native required attribute from the inputs (via a container-level flag), so radio validation keeps working inside popups.
  • Fixed: Address subfield validation preserves the camelCase keys addressLine1 / addressLine2 so per-component labels and Required rules resolve correctly on submit.
  • Improved: conditional-logic.js and multistep.js are now versioned by file modification time, so browser and CDN caches automatically pick up future frontend script fixes without requiring a full plugin version bump.

1.3

  • New: Redesigned plugin dashboard — personalized hero header, four KPI cards (forms, submissions, unread, and this week with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day submission activity chart, recent entries, top-performing-forms ranking, built-in add-on status, quick actions, and a guided onboarding card when no forms exist yet.
  • New: Multi-step forms — enable in Form Settings and split any form with Page Break fields, with step titles, custom Next/Previous button labels, and multiple progress bar styles.
  • New: Step branching — skip a step or jump ahead based on earlier answers (forward-only, loop-safe), so every visitor only sees the steps that apply to them.
  • New: Partial entry capture — optionally save in-progress answers, review them under Partial Entries, and auto-delete abandoned entries after a configurable retention period (1–365 days).
  • New: Slack Notifications add-on — post a message to a Slack channel the moment a form is submitted, using Slack Incoming Webhooks. Enable notifications per form, send different forms to different channels, choose per form whether the submitted answers are included, and verify your setup with a one-click test message. Only hooks.slack.com webhook URLs are accepted, no Slack credentials are stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.
  • Improved: Survey field answers in notification emails — ratings and scales show as score/max with end labels, and matrix answers list each question clearly (no NPS segment labels in confirmation emails).
  • Fixed: Duplicating a form now regenerates field IDs and remaps conditional logic, branching, settings, and email merge tags, so copies never collide with the original on the same page.
  • Fixed: Checkbox/radio, email, and searchable dropdown handlers work correctly when the same form is rendered more than once (e.g. page + popup).
  • Fixed: Conditionally hidden fields stay hidden even when a site serves a stale cached stylesheet.
  • Fixed: Required checkbox groups are validated correctly on the frontend.

1.2.9

  • New: Survey field types — a new “Survey” category in the form builder with four field types, all free: Tabular Survey (a rows × columns Likert grid with an optional multiple-answers-per-row mode that collapses neatly on mobile), Star Rating (3–10 stars, keyboard accessible), NPS (the standard 0–10 Net Promoter Score scale with color-coded answers), and Opinion Scale (numbered 0/1–10 buttons with custom labels for each end).
  • New: Survey Results page — a new admin screen with visual, per-question results: answer distribution charts for ratings and scales, stacked bar charts for tabular surveys, option counts for radio/dropdown/checkbox questions, an automatic NPS score with the Promoter/Passive/Detractor breakdown, and a 30-day response trend.
  • New: Survey answers are shown in a readable format in the entry details (stars, NPS segment badges, per-question matrix answers) and CSV exports now write structured answers as readable text instead of raw code.
  • New: Conditional logic works with all survey fields — for example, show a “What can we improve?” question only when the NPS score is 6 or less. Rules on a tabular survey match any row’s answer, and the rule editor now shows guidance (valid ranges, tips) when a survey field is selected.
  • Improved: Survey fields follow the form’s Customize colors — scale buttons, matrix answers, and focus outlines use the form’s primary color instead of a fixed blue.
  • Fixed: Star rating and tabular survey accessibility labels could appear as visible text on themes without screen-reader styles; the plugin now ships its own.
  • Fixed: Form Analytics add-on charts load again — the Chart.js library it relies on is now shipped with the plugin.

1.2.8

  • New: Gutenberg block — insert any form directly from the block editor. Pick the form from a dropdown and see a live, styled preview right in the editor; the block always renders the latest version of the form, so no shortcodes are needed.
  • New: WordPress dashboard widget — see your forms, total and unread submissions, and this week’s activity at a glance on the main WordPress dashboard, with a 7-day submissions chart, the latest entries (unread highlighted), and one-click shortcuts to create a form or open submissions.
  • New: Prefill from URL parameters — enable “Prefill from URL Parameter” on text, email, phone, number, dropdown, and radio fields to fill them automatically from links like ?business-name=Acme. Also works for forms embedded on other websites: the host page’s URL parameters are forwarded to the embedded form securely.
  • New: Color Picker field — let visitors pick a color with the native color selector. The chosen color is validated, stored with the submission, and shown as a color swatch next to its hex code in the entry details.

1.2.7

  • New: User Registration & Login add-on — create WordPress accounts automatically from form submissions. Map form fields to the account email, username, password, and first/last name (a single Full Name field is split automatically), choose the role new users receive (Administrator is never selectable), and respect or override the site’s “Anyone can register” setting. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and never stored with the submission or included in any email.
  • New: Independent login form — the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode now handles signing in, lost password, and password reset entirely on your own page; visitors never see the default WordPress login screen. Error and confirmation messages appear inline and never reveal whether an account exists.
  • New: Login form appearance settings — customize the username/password labels, button text, five colors (button, button text, text, links, background), and corner radius from the add-on settings page.
  • New: Custom welcome email — replace the standard WordPress new-user email with your own subject and message, using placeholders such as {username}, {email}, {first_name}, {site_name}, {login_url}, and {set_password_url}.
  • Improved: Webhooks, analytics, and other submission actions now also run for forms whose confirmation is a redirect (previously they were skipped for redirect-only forms).
  • Developer: New auto_form_builder_processed_submission_data filter lets add-ons adjust submission data before it is stored, emailed, or passed to webhooks.

1.2.6

  • New: Conditional confirmations — show a different success message or redirect to a different thank-you page based on the visitor’s answers, with multiple rules combined using AND/OR logic (first matching rule wins).
  • New: Conditional email rules — skip the admin notification or send it to a different address with a different subject and message based on the visitor’s answers; the user confirmation email can be skipped or customized the same way.
  • New: Plain text email format — choose between the styled HTML layout and a simple plain-text format for admin notifications and user confirmation emails, per form.
  • New: Custom Message field for admin notification emails — write your own notification body with the same placeholders as the confirmation email, such as {submission_data} and {form_name}.
  • New: Help text on the Forms screen explaining the difference between the shortcode Copy button (this website) and the Copy embed code button (any other website).

1.2.5

  • New: Signature field — let visitors draw an e-signature (mouse, touch or stylus) that is saved with the submission and shown in the entry details. Works on regular pages and embedded forms.
  • Fixed: Fields left without a label or name no longer show their internal ID (a string of numbers) in the entry view and email notifications — a friendly field-type name is shown instead.

1.2.4

  • New: Embed forms on any website — copy a ready-made embed code from the Forms screen and paste it into any site, even non-WordPress platforms and page builders. The embedded form keeps its original design, auto-resizes to fit its content, and stays isolated from the host theme’s styles.
  • New: “Break out of iframe” option for redirect thank-you pages — optionally open the redirect page in the full browser window instead of inside the embedded frame (off by default, so existing behaviour is unchanged).
  • Improved: Embedded forms load reliably alongside caching/optimization plugins (LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache) so auto-resize works out of the box.

1.2.3

  • New: Inline validation for searchable dropdowns and pattern/format input rules — invalid fields now show an inline error message, are visually marked, block submission, and the form scrolls to and focuses the first invalid field. Errors clear automatically as the visitor corrects them.
  • New: Opt-in, anonymous Usage Data — an optional, off-by-default setting (available in the onboarding screen and under Settings → General) that sends a one-time anonymous “install” event when you opt in and an “uninstall” event when the plugin is deleted, so we can measure the uninstall rate and prioritise improvements. Fully anonymous (random local site ID only), https-only, and never sends your site URL, email, IP, or any form/submission content. See the “External Services” section for the full disclosure.

short_description: Drag & drop AI form builder for WordPress. Build forms with AI, add conversational forms & an AI assistant, embed anywhere. Free core builder.
description:
Support

Watch the full overview video below.

Auto Form Builder is a free drag-and-drop WordPress form builder for creating professional forms — contact forms, multi-step forms, surveys, file upload forms, and forms with conditional logic — without writing a single line of code.

It also brings AI to your forms. With the optional AI add-ons you can build a form with AI from a plain-English description or an uploaded document, generate conditional logic automatically, summarize and draft replies to submissions, ask questions across all your submissions, and use a built-in admin AI assistant that answers questions about your forms and even creates new ones. You can also turn any form into an AI conversational form — a friendly chat that collects answers naturally instead of a static layout.

The core drag-and-drop builder and every non-AI feature are completely free, with no upsells hidden behind core functionality. The AI features are optional and off by default: they connect to our AIDA service only after you opt in, with free trial credits to start and paid credit packs afterward (see the “External Services” section for the full disclosure).

Why Auto Form Builder?

Most form plugins lock their best features behind expensive subscriptions. Auto Form Builder gives you multi-step forms, conditional logic, surveys, form analytics, spam protection, submission management, webhooks, Slack notifications, import/export, and full visual customization — all completely free.

Plugin Dashboard

Your command center for everything forms-related. The plugin dashboard opens with a personalized greeting and live summary, four KPI cards (total forms, total submissions, unread entries, and this week’s activity with a week-over-week trend), a 14-day submission activity chart, the latest entries, a top-performing-forms ranking, built-in add-on status at a glance, and one-click shortcuts to create forms, open settings, or get support. If you have not created a form yet, a guided onboarding card walks you through the first three steps.

Drag & Drop Form Builder

Building a form takes minutes. Open the builder, drag your fields onto the canvas, and you’re done. The builder supports undo/redo, a live preview with desktop, tablet, and mobile views, and instant shortcode generation so you can embed your form anywhere on your site.

Embed Forms on Any Website

Your forms aren’t locked to your WordPress site. Every form comes with a ready-made embed code you can copy from the Forms screen and paste onto any website — including sites that don’t run WordPress, and page builders such as WP Bakery, Brizy, and Elementor. The embedded form keeps the exact design you built, automatically resizes to fit its content with no inner scrollbar, and stays isolated from the host site’s theme so it always looks right. You can even choose to have a redirect thank-you page open in the full browser window, breaking out of the frame. It’s the same secure form, working anywhere you place it.

15+ Field Types

Every common field type is included:

  • Text Input
  • Textarea
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Date & Time
  • Checkbox
  • Radio Buttons
  • Dropdown
  • Name Field
  • Address
  • File Upload
  • Signature
  • Color Picker
  • Page Break (multi-step forms)
  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid)
  • Star Rating
  • NPS (0–10)
  • Opinion Scale

Signature Field

Collect legally-style e-signatures right inside your form. Visitors sign with a mouse, finger, or stylus on a signature pad, and the drawing is saved with the submission. Signatures are stored securely and shown as an image in the entry details, so they’re perfect for consent forms, agreements, and approvals — and they work both on your WordPress pages and in embedded forms.

Survey Fields & Visual Results

Build complete surveys with four dedicated question types — features other form plugins charge for, included here free:

  • Tabular Survey (Likert grid) — rows of questions with your own answer columns, as radio buttons or checkboxes (multiple answers per row). The table collapses neatly on mobile.
  • Star Rating — 3 to 10 stars with hover preview, fully keyboard and touch accessible.
  • NPS (0–10) — the standard “How likely are you to recommend us?” Net Promoter Score scale with color-coded Detractor/Passive/Promoter answers.
  • Opinion Scale — numbered buttons with custom labels for each end, like “Not likely” and “Very likely”.

Then open the Survey Results screen for visual, per-question reports: answer distribution charts for ratings and scales, stacked bars for tabular surveys, an automatically calculated NPS score with the Promoter/Passive/Detractor breakdown, and a 30-day response trend. Survey answers also appear beautifully formatted in the entry details and as readable text in CSV exports — and conditional logic works with every survey field, so you can show follow-up questions based on a visitor’s rating.

Color Picker Field

Let visitors choose a color using the browser’s native color picker — ideal for design requests, product personalization, and print orders. The selected color is validated, stored with the submission, and displayed as a color swatch next to its hex code in the entry details.

Pre-Built Templates

Start faster with ready-to-use form templates including Contact Form, Feedback Form, Support Request, Newsletter Signup, Event Registration, and more. Every template is fully customizable after creation.

Conditional Logic

Show or hide any field based on what a user has already entered. Set multiple conditions per field using AND or OR logic. Build smart, dynamic forms that adapt to each visitor — all without any code.

Conditional logic goes beyond fields. You can also show a different success message or redirect to a different thank-you page depending on the visitor’s answers, and control your emails with the same rules — route the admin notification to a different address, change its subject or message, skip it entirely, or send a different confirmation email to the user. The first matching rule wins, and if nothing matches your normal settings apply.

Multi-Step Forms

Break long forms into short, friendly steps and watch your completion rates climb. Enable multi-step mode in Form Settings, then drop Page Break fields wherever a new step should begin. Give each step its own title, customize the Next and Previous button labels, and pick a progress bar style so visitors always know how far along they are.

Step branching makes multi-step forms smart: skip a step or jump ahead based on earlier answers (forward-only and loop-safe), so every visitor only sees the steps that apply to them. Perfect for application forms, quote requests, registrations, and questionnaires.

Partial Entries — Capture Abandoned Forms

Don’t lose a lead just because someone didn’t press Submit. With partial entry capture enabled, in-progress answers are saved while visitors fill out your form, and you can review them on the Partial Entries screen. Abandoned entries are deleted automatically after a retention period you control (1–365 days), keeping your data tidy and privacy-friendly.

Full Visual Customization

Make your forms match your brand perfectly. The Customize tab gives you control over:

  • Theme presets — Corporate, Minimal, Modern, Eco, Friendly, Luxury, Neutral, Creative, Feminine, Fresh, and more
  • Header image / banner per form
  • Background, colors, fonts, layout
  • Field styling and button design
  • Visual effects

Every change is previewed live across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Submission Management

All your form submissions are organized in a clean inbox-style interface with Unread, Starred, Read, Spam, and Trash tabs. Search submissions by any field value — name, email, phone, or any custom field. Filter by form or date range, sort by newest or oldest, and print submissions directly from the dashboard.

Email Notifications

Get notified instantly when a form is submitted. Admin notification emails and user confirmation emails are both supported and fully configurable per form — recipients, subject, and a custom message with placeholders like {submission_data} and {form_name}. Choose between a styled HTML layout or a simple plain-text format for each email, and use conditional rules to send different emails (or none at all) based on the visitor’s answers.

Form Analytics

Track exactly how your forms are performing. The analytics dashboard shows total views, total submissions, average conversion rate, and per-form breakdowns — all with a 30-day activity chart. Sync historical submissions, and reset data anytime. Form analytics is included free and activatable from the Add-Ons page.

Spam Protection

Two spam protection options are included free:

  • Google reCAPTCHA — industry-standard bot protection
  • Cloudflare Turnstile — a privacy-first, user-friendly CAPTCHA alternative with a better experience for real visitors

Both are activatable from the Add-Ons page. Use one or both on any form.

User Registration & Login

Turn any form into a registration form. Map your form’s fields to the account email, username, password, and first/last name (a single Full Name field is split automatically), pick the role new users receive (Administrator is never allowed), and optionally send your own custom welcome email with placeholders like {username} and {set_password_url}. Passwords are handled by WordPress core and are never stored with the submission or included in notification emails.

The add-on also gives you a fully independent login form via the [auto_form_builder_login] shortcode. Signing in, lost password, and choosing a new password all happen on your own page — visitors never see the default WordPress login screen. Customize the labels, button text, colors, and corner radius to match your site.

Import & Export

Export your forms and entries for backup or migration. Import forms onto any WordPress site in seconds. Perfect for agencies managing multiple client sites.

Slack Notifications

Get your team notified in Slack the moment a form is submitted. Activate the free Slack Notifications add-on, paste a Slack Incoming Webhook URL from your own workspace, and choose which forms send a message — different forms can post to different Slack channels. Decide per form whether the submitted answers are included, and verify your setup with a one-click test message.

Built with safety first: only hooks.slack.com webhook URLs are accepted, no Slack credentials are ever stored, and passwords and file contents are never sent.

Webhooks

Connect your forms to any external service or automation platform using built-in webhook support. Send submission data to Zapier, Make, or any custom endpoint the moment a form is submitted.

Extend with Paid Add-Ons

The free plugin is complete and fully functional on its own. For teams and agencies that want to go further, premium add-ons are available to extend specific functionality.

Auto Form CRM Integration

Auto Form Builder integrates natively with Auto Form CRM, a dedicated WordPress CRM plugin built for managing leads and form submissions in one place.

AI Features (Optional Add-Ons)

Two optional AI add-ons are available and off by default: AI Assistant (build a form from a description or an uploaded document, one-click submission summaries and suggested replies, “ask across your submissions”, and an admin chat assistant that can answer questions about your forms and even create new forms) and AI Conversation (turn a form into a friendly chat that collects answers conversationally, with optional appointment booking).

These features connect to AIDA, our AI service at autoformcrm.com. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you activate an AI add-on and connect a free AIDA account. New accounts include free trial credits; after the trial, AI usage requires one-time credit packs purchased on autoformcrm.com — so the AI features are a paid service, while the core form builder and every non-AI feature stay completely free and never require an account. Your credit balance is always visible inside the plugin. See the “External Services” section below for exactly what data is sent, when, and to whom.

External Services

Auto Form Builder is privacy-first. By default the plugin does not contact any external service. The following optional services are off by default and only ever run after you actively opt in:

AIDA — AI Assistant & AI Conversation (optional add-ons, off by default)

  • Service: AIDA — the AI service that powers the plugin’s optional AI features.
  • Provider: Auto Form Builder / Auto Form CRM (https://autoformcrm.com/). AIDA processes each request using a third-party AI provider, Anthropic (https://www.anthropic.com/).
  • When it is contacted: Only after a site administrator activates one of the optional AI add-ons (AI Assistant or AI Conversation) and connects an AIDA account, and then uses an AI feature. If the AI add-ons are not activated, or you never connect an account, nothing is ever sent to AIDA. The core form builder never contacts AIDA.
  • Account required: Using the AI features requires an AIDA account. Creating an account is free and includes free trial credits; once the trial credits are used, continued AI usage requires purchasing credits (one-time credit packs, purchased on autoformcrm.com). In other words, the AI features are a paid service after the free trial, while the core Auto Form Builder plugin and all non-AI features remain completely free and never require an account.
  • Data that is sent, and when:
    • Form building (AI Assistant): the form description you type, and the contents of any document you upload to build a form from, are sent when you request an AI-generated form.
    • Submission AI (AI Assistant): the content of the specific submission(s) you act on is sent when you request a summary, a suggested reply, or an “ask across submissions” answer, and when the admin chat assistant uses its data tools to answer a question about your forms or submissions.
    • Admin chat assistant (AI Assistant): the messages you type into the assistant are sent when you send them.
    • Conversations (AI Conversation): if you enable the AI Conversation add-on on a public form, the chat messages that site visitors type into that form’s assistant are sent when they send them, so the assistant can reply and collect the form’s answers.
    • Authentication: your AIDA account connection token is sent (server-side only) to authenticate each request. It is stored encrypted on your server and is never exposed to the browser.
  • Data that is NOT sent: no request is made for any AI feature you do not use, and no submission or form content is sent outside of the AI action you trigger. Passwords handled by WordPress core are never sent.
  • Metering: AI usage is metered in credits. Your current balance is shown in the plugin’s AI settings, and you can buy more credits at any time — this always opens autoformcrm.com in a new browser tab; no payment is ever processed inside the plugin.
  • Purpose: To provide the optional AI features — AI-assisted form building, submission summaries and replies, the admin assistant, and visitor-facing conversational forms.
  • Provider terms / privacy policy: https://autoformcrm.com/terms and https://autoformcrm.com/privacy (Auto Form CRM / AIDA). AI processing is performed by Anthropic — see https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy.

Anonymous Deactivation Feedback (opt-in, one-time)

  • Service: Auto Form Builder feedback endpoint
  • Endpoint: https://autoformbuilder.com/afb-deactivation-feedback.php
  • Provider: Auto Form Builder (https://autoformbuilder.com/)

upgrade_notice.1.1.1: New features: Customize Form styling panel, Form Analytics, reCAPTCHA Protection, and Cloudflare Turnstile add-ons. Activate add-ons from the Add-Ons page.
upgrade_notice.1.1.0: Critical fix: Resolves CSS conflicts with WooCommerce and other plugins. Highly recommended update for all users.
upgrade_notice.1.0.9: New feature: Send confirmation emails to users after form submission! Configure in Form Settings.
upgrade_notice.1.0.8: Customize your submit button text! Change the default "Submit" to any text you want.
upgrade_notice.1.0.7: Adds support for premium add-ons (Entry Tags, Google Sheets). Recommended update.
upgrade_notice.1.0.6: Fixes CSS conflicts. Recommended for all Auto Form Builder users.
upgrade_notice.1.0.4: New form templates! Create Contact, Feedback, Support, Newsletter, and Event Registration forms instantly.
upgrade_notice.1.0.0: Welcome to Auto Form Builder! Create your first form in minutes.
